mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and can prolong QT interval; prochlorperazine also prolongs QT interval and lowers seizure threshold, creating additive cardiac and neurological risks.
action: Monitor ECG, electrolytes (especially calcium and magnesium), and seizure activity; consider alternative antiemetic if possible; ensure aggressive electrolyte repletion during foscarnet therapy.
